Class WorldManager

java.lang.Object
gamemode.forest.util.WorldManager
public class WorldManager extends Object
Manages the state of the forest game world, including chunk loading, dinosaur spawning, item pickup, collision detection, and battle triggering.

The world is divided into square Chunks of size CHUNK_SIZE. Each update tick, chunks within RENDER_DISTANCE of the player are loaded asynchronously. Dinosaurs are spawned once per chunk when it first enters render distance, and despawned when defeated or caught.

Dinosaur spawn probabilities per chunk:

  • 25% base chance that a chunk attempts to spawn any dinosaur.
  • 50% — Common (LongNeck or Raptor, chosen randomly)
  • 35% — Uncommon (Triceratops or T-Rex, chosen randomly)
  • 15% — Rare (Ancient Colossus / MegaDinosaur)

    • update

      public void update()
      Processes one game tick for the world.

      Each tick this method:

      1. Loads any unloaded chunks within RENDER_DISTANCE of the player, asynchronously via the thread pool.
      2. Attempts to spawn a dinosaur in each newly entered chunk.
      3. Updates every active dinosaur's AI via Dinosaur.update(Player).
      4. Checks for player-dinosaur collisions and triggers a battle if one is found and no battle is already in progress.

    • removeDinosaur

    • handlePickup

      public void handlePickup()
      Attempts to pick up the nearest WorldItem within range of the player.

      Iterates all loaded chunks and removes the first item within 80 units of the player, adding it to the player's inventory. Shows a dialogue if the inventory is full or on successful pickup. Does nothing if no item is in range.

    • isNearPlayer

      public boolean isNearPlayer(WorldItem item)
      Returns whether the given world item is within pickup range of the player. Pickup range is 80 units (compared using squared distance for efficiency).
      Parameters:
      item - the WorldItem to check
      Returns:
      true if the item is within 80 units of the player's position

    • isColliding

      public boolean isColliding(Player p, Dinosaur d)
      Returns whether the player and a dinosaur are overlapping using axis-aligned bounding box collision with a 50% shrink factor applied to both entities, reducing false positives from large sprites.
      Parameters:
      p - the player entity
      d - the dinosaur entity
      Returns:
      true if their shrunk bounding boxes overlap

    • endBattle

      public void endBattle()
      Ends the current battle and resets battle state.

      Removes the battle dinosaur from the world, clears its chunk's spawn record so a fresh dinosaur can appear, then calls pushPlayerOut() to ensure the player is not immediately overlapping any remaining dinosaur.

    • shutdown

      public void shutdown()
      Shuts down the chunk-loading thread pool immediately. Should be called when leaving the forest scene to release resources.
